proposals.title: Explicit ORBITS coverage and analysis product
proposals.reason: ORB appears in the role legend but in none of the 33 output-row role mappings.
proposals.acceptance: Use the actual approved field definitions. Missing definitions remain pending. A six-lens operator map is not interchangeable with ORBITS; no invented field completion.

proposals.title: Workspace setup and routing plan, with later authorized-action receipts
proposals.reason: The matrix specifies manifests and health reports but no dedicated operational setup/routing product for the requested folder automation.
proposals.acceptance: Phase 1 is preview-only. Do not recreate 42 folders or rename to 21. Later execution requires scoped approval, preserves originals and refuses overwrite.

proposals.title: Operational review/voting queue and policy evaluation
proposals.reason: M24 is review history; it does not fully specify incoming tasks, voter eligibility, revision-bound votes, quorum/authority policy and outstanding decisions.
proposals.acceptance: Idempotent actor/revision-bound events; no invented quorum, source self-approval or model canon; old votes do not approve edited content.
